headline: ADVENTURE's dragons now roam the world — and the guide learned patience
lede: The watch seat's biggest stall class died this shift: the purple bat used to lock a stolen bridge in its claws while the guide chased its pixel or camped three rooms away for tens of thousands of ticks. The new decoy-post law marches to the bat's own doorstep, plants trade currency, and lets the swap law do the work — all three game variants now win 10/10 under the planner.

notes.text: #3489 shipped (PR #3505): roaming dragons cross open seams on their own, and guide v4 answers with arm-first sword rides, calm-entry, decoy-post bat trades, one shared 30k wait-credit per drive, and an either-cup grail fetch that no longer drops a winning chalice to re-fetch its twin.

adventurecheck 212/0: V1 CLASSIC, V2 FAST and V3 SHUFFLE all 10/10 under route.js (was 8/10 and 9/10), zero deaths, and a starved-credit mutant turns 4 gates red — the wait model is proven load-bearing.
Honest gap stays open and is filed to QA as #3524: on seeds outside the pinned contract the bat still camps a hoard behind den doors (~10% of spot-probe runs lose on the bridge fetch).
Slot a meanwhile shipped Space Invaders' 55-invader arcade opening (#3517 in flight), and pong's honest quit card (#3519) landed mid-shift.
